Name: Kedi's Furniture Tweaks
Author: KeDili
Description:
[b][size=4]Features [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Couches are made shorter since they look too strecthed to the eye, the mod will adjust your position so that the farmer isn't floating. (Each one is configurable, so don't worry compatibility!)[/size]
[*][size=3]All beds and one rug from Penny's 14 heart decorations are changed[/size]
[*][size=3]Totem Pole has been slightly edited and Monster Rug is recolored.[/size]
[*][size=3]Modern Bench has become more square than triangle[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Compatibility [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Compatible with both 1.5.6 and any 1.6.X versions[/size]
[*][size=3]No known incompatible mods.[/size]
[/list][url=https://github.com/KediDili/FurnitureTweaks][size=3]
